note: Each answer is one GET as SourceTransport received it; the body file holds its exact bytes (gzipped when it ends .gz). 'breaks' names today's rule a test shows failing; 'owner_ticket' owns its fix.

naming-nz-sequence.case: E. coli ATCC 25922 (GCF_000743255.1): its chromosome is RefSeq NZ_CP009072.1, the name of every E. coli complete-genome RefSeq sequence.
naming-nz-sequence.breaks: investigation_sources.SEQUENCE_ACCESSION refuses NZ_CP009072.1, so named_sequences_of raises and the whole sequence report goes unread (also providers/ncbi_investigation._SEQUENCE, paper_text._SEQUENCE). Fixed by #467: the whole FTP assembly report is copied and the model names the sequence, checked by membership.

naming-wgs-scaffold.case: Dog CanFam3.1 (GCF_000002285.3, now 'previous'): unplaced scaffolds named by WGS accession, e.g. GenBank AAEX03018827.1 = RefSeq NW_003726146.1 = UCSC chrUn_AAEX03018827.
naming-wgs-scaffold.breaks: ncbi_investigation.fetch_sequence_report asks role_filters=assembled-molecule, so no unplaced scaffold reaches the reader; a site on one is 'names no sequence'. Fixed by #467: the whole FTP assembly report is copied and the model names the sequence, checked by membership.

naming-mitochondrion.case: Human GRCh38.p14 (GCF_000001405.40): the mitochondrion is MT / chrM / NC_012920.1 / J01415.2; a paper may write chrMT, M or m.
naming-mitochondrion.breaks: investigation_sources name_sequence keeps a written contig only when it is literally one of the report's names, while paper_text.contig_name (the stated-version path) folds chr/Chromosome prefixes by grammar: two code rules that disagree and neither lets the model match. Fixed by #467: the whole FTP assembly report is copied and the model names the sequence, checked by membership.

naming-roman-chromosome.case: S. cerevisiae R64 (GCF_000146045.2): chromosome IV is IV / chrIV / NC_001136.10 / BK006938.2; sacCer1-era papers write chr4.
naming-roman-chromosome.breaks: name_sequence's literal membership and paper_text.contig_name both miss arabic for roman; today the curated StatedSequences table patches it (#459/#414). Fixed by #467: the whole FTP assembly report is copied and the model names the sequence, checked by membership.

naming-plant-chromosome.case: Arabidopsis TAIR10 (GCF_000001735.4): NCBI names chromosome 1 only 1 / NC_003070.9 / CP002684.1 (no UCSC name); TAIR papers write Chr1, ChrC, ChrM.
naming-plant-chromosome.breaks: name_sequence's literal membership refuses Chr1; paper_text._CHROMOSOME reads no ChrC/Pltd. Fixed by #467: the whole FTP assembly report is copied and the model names the sequence, checked by membership.

naming-large-report.case: Wheat IWGSC CS RefSeq v2.1 (GCF_018294505.1): 21 chromosomes, plastid and mitochondrion, and 91,588 scaffolds.
naming-large-report.breaks: The sequence report's role filter hides every scaffold and named_sequences_of names no cut; the FTP assembly report breaks describe_companion's 1 MiB bound (SourceAnswerTooLarge), so the prebuilt-index search is 'unavailable'. Fixed by #467: the whole FTP assembly report is copied and the model names the sequence, checked by membership.

naming-galaxy-unit.case: Mouse GRCm39 (GCF_000001635.27), listed in Galaxy's BRC bwa_mem_index catalogue: its assembly report names the primary unit C57BL/6J.
naming-galaxy-unit.breaks: prebuilt_index.search.PRIMARY_UNITS was the name set {Primary Assembly, non-nuclear}, so no mouse chromosome was requested and the pre-fit was refused; #464 selects the Run's sequences by NCBI's Sequence-Role (REFERENCE_ROLES).

naming-galaxy-human.case: Human GRCh38.p14 (GCF_000001405.40), Galaxy BRC's prebuilt BWA index: its .ann names 455 contigs, NCBI's 25 assembled molecules and unlocalized and unplaced scaffolds under UCSC names and the alt loci (#457 human a1). Read with naming-galaxy-unit's catalogues and naming-mitochondrion's assembly report.
naming-galaxy-human.breaks: The retired code-side search's pre-fit refused it: 455 contigs against NCBI's 191, 264 not one requested sequence (#457 a1). #464: the model reads the candidate's contigs as facts, every requested sequence paired and each extra with its NCBI role, and chooses.

assembly-species-pages.case: E. coli, taxon 562: NCBI lists hundreds of thousands of assemblies (two reference_only).
assembly-species-pages.breaks: Discovery asks one 100-row page and never pages; rows of descendant taxa are filtered incompatible_taxon, the rest ranked and cut to 3, a truncated listing forced ambiguous; Investigation's RefSeq listing is refused when it runs past a page. Fixed by #471: discovery copies NCBI's own page with its total_count and page token, and a stated version is found by NCBI's own search.

assembly-strain.case: E. coli K-12 MG1655, taxon 511145 (about a hundred assemblies).
assembly-strain.breaks: ncbi_datasets matches strain by casefold substring with at most MAX_DESCENDANT_TAXON_CHECKS lineage checks, and discovery keeps three code-ranked candidates of one page. Fixed by #471: the strain's own TaxId is listed page by page, every row copied; no substring or lineage check.

assembly-genbank-only.case: Loblolly pine, taxon 3352: assemblies in GenBank only.
assembly-genbank-only.breaks: ncbi_investigation.fetch_taxon_assemblies lists RefSeq only and stated_version_sequence requires a RefSeq sequence, so a stated GenBank assembly is 'names no' (#393 G1 A, superseded by ADR 0049). Fixed by #471: a stated version is searched over every source.

assembly-suppressed.case: Horse EquCab3.0: RefSeq GCF_002863925.1 is suppressed, GenBank GCA_002863925.1 current; breed thoroughbred, isolate Twilight, sex female.
assembly-suppressed.breaks: Discovery rejects the suppressed RefSeq row by a status substring (decision 'rejected suppressed') and keeps the first infraspecific field only; the source's own status never reaches the model as a copied field. Fixed by #471: every row is copied with NCBI's status and every infraspecific field.

assembly-stated-grch37.case: GRCh37 stated on a GRCh38 Run: NCBI names GRCh37 GCF_000001405.13 and its patch releases GRCh37.p1-p13 (GCF_000001405.14-.25).
assembly-stated-grch37.breaks: investigation_request.same_version strips the GRC patch (_GRC_PATCH) and stated_version_sequence picks the latest version, so 'GRCh37' resolves to GRCh37.p13 (GCF_000001405.25), a code choice (#417, #393 G1 A, superseded). Fixed by #471: the model names the version, and a caller with no model takes only the row literally named GRCh37.

variant-eva-retired.case: EVA rs160719159: HTTP 410 whose body is the retired record on sheep GCA_000298735.2 (taxon 9940), as #457's C. elegans check met it.
variant-eva-retired.breaks: _EvaLookup.run maps every non-2xx answer to status malformed ('not a clustered variant'), a verdict on the source's own answer.

variant-non-human-snp.case: C. elegans rs7089734242 on WBcel235 (GCF_000002985.6): EVA holds it; dbSNP holds no non-human record.
variant-non-human-snp.breaks: HUMAN_ASSEMBLY_SERIES/lookup_source_of route a Run to one lookup Tool and drop the other (investigation_agent.investigation_tools). Fixed by #469: both lookup Tools are offered on every Run, the model chooses the source, and dbSNP's no record is its answer for the model to read before it asks EVA.

variant-dbsnp-non-ptlp.case: dbSNP rs429358 (APOE): its GRCh37 placement NC_000019.9 is not the primary top-level placement (is_ptlp false).
variant-dbsnp-non-ptlp.breaks: _PlacedAlleles reads only is_ptlp placements, so on a GRCh37 Run the record has 'no eligible placement on the exact assembly'.

variant-merged.case: dbSNP rs60037639, merged into rs4149056 (a passing control: merged_into is copied today).
variant-merged.breaks: none today for dbSNP (control); EVA's merge answer has no recording (none found, #468 Q3 conditional).

variant-dbsnp-withdrawn.case: dbSNP rs94: a withdrawn record (withdrawn_snapshot_data, first entry of NCBI's refsnp-withdrawn list).
variant-dbsnp-withdrawn.breaks: normalize_refsnp reads only primary_snapshot_data, so a withdrawn record falls to not_found 'no eligible placement' (#468 Q5).

identifiers-rsid-text.case: A researcher's answer naming two rsIDs, 'not rs429358, I meant rs7412': the two dbSNP records.
identifiers-rsid-text.breaks: investigation_request.researcher_rsids / effective_requested_rsid read rsIDs from free text by IdentifierRule (answer_value, stated), so a rejected rsID stays admissible. Fixed by #472: the model types the rsID an answer means, quoting it, and code checks only membership.

identifiers-hgvs-text.case: A site written as HGVS g. in free text: NC_049231.1:g.69888722_69888723del (dog, s16's train paper). NCBI's HGVS service answers 400 'The submitted sequence is not human.'
identifiers-hgvs-text.breaks: paper_text.written_position reads positions by grammar and returns None for a g. deletion, so the target stays untyped_target. The recorded 400 shows NCBI's HGVS service reads human sequences only (#473's validation route). Fixed by #472: the model types the g. site by its first position, checked by membership.

biology-genetic-code.case: S. cerevisiae R64: ATP6 (Q0085) is one mitochondrial CDS on NC_001224.1 (28487-29266, transl_table=3); its codon 68 (28688-28690) is TGA, Trp under table 3.
biology-genetic-code.breaks: target_request.gene_change.CODE is the standard table and the GFF reader drops transl_table, so a TGA Trp codon reads as a stop. Fixed by #469: each transcript's translation table is copied from its CDS's transl_table (table 1 when none is written, marked default) and translates its codons.

variant-many-placements.case: Cattle rs109500000 placed on more than five (assembly, contig) pairs. DERIVED: no real EVA record with more than five placements was found in 67 probes (owner Q8 a, 2026-10-27); the served clustered answer is rs109500000's real answer (4 placements) plus two real placements of rs41255587 on other assemblies, re-keyed to accession 109500000.
variant-many-placements.breaks: investigation_sources.MAX_EVA_PLACEMENT_SEQUENCES = 5: past five distinct (assembly, contig) pairs _EvaLookup returns ambiguous with no placement copied.

derived.transformation: rs109500000's four placements as recorded, then rs41255587's placements on GCA_000003055.5/GK000007.2 and GCA_000003205.1/CM000183.4 with accession set to 109500000; compact JSON as EVA writes it.

biology-ploidy.case: A haploid bacterium's calls (GT 1, 0 on B. subtilis NZ_CP020102.1) and a tetraploid's (GT 0/0/1/1, 0/0/0/0 and the mixed-phase 0/1|1 VCF 4.3 allows), as tiny VCF 4.3 files.
biology-ploidy.breaks: vcf_observation._assess_genotype stamps a haploid call phased=False and refuses a genotype carrying both / and | as malformed (owner Q7 a). Fixed by #470: a genotype is read by its alleles under either separator; phased is a bool only when every separator agrees, and None for a one-allele or mixed-separator call (owner #470 Q4 a).

inputs.name: haploid.vcf
inputs.origin: synthetic for #466: two haploid records at invented positions on B. subtilis NZ_CP020102.1

inputs.name: polyploid.vcf
inputs.origin: synthetic for #466: three tetraploid records on wheat chromosome 1A NC_057794.1 at invented positions

paper-allele-labels.case: A paper table whose allele columns are headed 'Major allele' and 'Minor allele', with no REF/ALT label word.
paper-allele-labels.breaks: target_request.paper_text._REF_COLUMNS / _ALT_COLUMNS decide REF and ALT by header words, so the row's alleles never reach the model to name their direction (owner option b of 2026-10-20, superseded by ADR 0049).

inputs.name: table.tsv
inputs.origin: synthetic for #466: an invented GWAS-style table row (chr2:1630127 C/A), no site of any eval case

variant-eva-by-position.case: C. elegans WBcel235 (GCF_000002985.6): rs7089734242, EVA's AG deletion at BX284603.4:931673 (NC_003281.10, chromosome III), stated as a VCF position; EVA lists it at that position under its own variantType DEL and answers INDEL with an empty 404 (#469 spike probes 1-2). Under contigNamingConvention=REFSEQ, with the sequence's RefSeq name, EVA lists it named NC_003281.10 (#469 review r1 SP4; the report gives the sequence no UCSC-style name).
variant-eva-by-position.breaks: _PositionLookup listed EVA's variants at a position only from the route and only under the type eva_form computes; the model could neither choose EVA nor name EVA's own variantType. Fixed by #469: locate_variant(source=, variant_type=), passed verbatim.

identifiers-hgvs-human.case: A human gene change typed from a researcher's words, BRAF V600E on its MANE transcript NM_004333.6 (c.1799T>A) and protein NP_004324.2: NCBI's HGVS service's own answers for the coding and the protein name, and the coding allele's equivalents.
identifiers-hgvs-human.breaks: ncbi_investigation._HGVS judged an HGVS name's spelling before NCBI answered, and _hgvs_check turned NCBI's reading into an agrees verdict. #473 (owner Q3 a) copies NCBI's answer, status and body, with no verdict.
